The  '''Goblin Burrows''' is a sub-location of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} connected to the {{Zone|Far Reserve}}.

== Purpose ==
The '''Goblin Burrows''' is home to {{MobSprite|Goblin}}s, {{MobSprite|Knifethrower}}s, and {{MobSprite|Fireslinger}}s. It features a passageway surrounded by gold blocks that opens up into a separate chamber.
